column1: # The repairs' case map: one row per renamed TEST_CASE or SUBCASE -- file, old name, new name,
# kind (bare: a leading lone letter or number taken off, a plan's step label nothing in the tree
# explains; reworded: a name that read as another claim, said as the case proves it). Applied and
# proved as map.tsv is, with --map (tools/phase-codes/apply.py, prove.py).

column2: e: a behaviour edit with the schema unchanged is a swap_state -- same WeaveId, Revived announced, state kept, the new body spent
column3: a behaviour edit with the schema unchanged is a swap_state -- same WeaveId, Revived announced, state kept, the new body spent

column2: e: a definition whose state schema differs is refused as a behaviour edit, and the live weave is untouched
column3: a definition whose state schema differs is refused as a behaviour edit, and the live weave is untouched

column2: f: a conversion the write refuses reaches no candidate -- the transaction aborts, the incumbent is resumed and is still the service
column3: a conversion the write refuses reaches no candidate -- the transaction aborts, the incumbent is resumed and is still the service

column2: f: the field-wise write refuses a target with no source, a source the schema lacks, a kind mismatch, two sources, a constant of a non-scalar kind, and a predecessor field neither copied nor dropped
column3: the field-wise write refuses a target with no source, a source the schema lacks, a kind mismatch, two sources, a constant of a non-scalar kind, and a predecessor field neither copied nor dropped

column2: b: a definition claiming another version is refused by its number, and one whose own version field disagrees with its envelope is a forgery
column3: a definition claiming another version is refused by its number, and one whose own version field disagrees with its envelope is a forgery

column2: b: the definition schema carries no author field, and the file says so
column3: the definition schema carries no author field, and the file says so

column2: b: a state file of another version is refused by name at load, and nothing converts it
column3: a state file of another version is refused by name at load, and nothing converts it

column2: a: a definition is refused when an on names an unaccepted message, an unknown output field, or an emit field with no source
column3: a definition is refused when an on names an unaccepted message, an unknown output field, or an emit field with no source

column2: e: an aborted succession discards the sealed candidate and leaves the incumbent the service with its state
column3: an aborted succession discards the sealed candidate and leaves the incumbent the service with its state
